title: Charge me after subscription cancellation
body: Extremely disappointed. Used a trial and after 2 days of using I canceled it and deleted the app. Surprisingly, after some time they still charged me 29.99$ for the year. Like how? Why? I already cancel it!!! Hopefully I’ll get a refund.
author: Mimimitchell

title: Nice app
body:
